description.value: Uncle Fatih's Pizza is a popular Vancouver-based pizza chain with this Downtown location on Nelson Street, known for fresh dough made daily and never-frozen ingredients. The menu leans heavily on vegetables and offers extensive customization including vegan cheese, gluten-free crust, and halal chicken options. With outdoor seating and online ordering for pickup or delivery, it's a practical and filling stop for cyclists moving through downtown Vancouver.

The catering FAQ explicitly confirms vegan cheese (Daiya), gluten-free crust (OGGI brand), and halal chicken; the menu lists an entire Veggie Pizzas section, and OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes corroborate this. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and most optional amenities are not mentioned in either OSM tags or website content, so they remain null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active fast-food restaurant in downtown Vancouver with confirmed vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options, outdoor seating, and pickup/delivery — a practical and accessible refuelling stop for touring cyclists.
